about: Work's fluidity budgets: the 2,000-task project's page (fluid-19), its list (fluid-17), a task's panel (fluid-18), the board (fluid-08) and the timeline (fluid-09); design/WIN-ALL-ROWS.md "fluidity" (FLUIDITY-LEAD, 20 Oct 2026). surfaces.mjs --only work measures each on a production build against the fake server side (workspace.mjs: the projects programme's harness shapes, 150 ms a round trip), on a computer at 1x (cpu1) and on a phone at 4x (cpu4).

measured is the median of 5 runs on beta 482460c3d, 20 Oct 2026: the computer's on P-cores at load 7 to 14; a rerun at load 25 to 37 agreed on every render count and DOM size and took 1.5 to 3 times as long. Where it is over target, max is that measure plus room for a shared machine (30% for a time, 5% for renders); where it is under, max is the target.
Renders hold from run to run and machine to machine: they are enforced. Times are printed against their max until they hold on a quiet P-core slot (heavy.sh --pcore).
Never raise a max to make a run pass. Lower it when a package brings a metric down, and to the target once the metric holds there.

desktop4 (21 Oct 2026, FLUIDITY-LEAD-2): a computer at 4x, for what the phone doesn't have or does differently (the board's drag, the list's keys, the timeline), never held to the phone's cpu4. Computer at 4x (surfaces.mjs --device desktop --cpu 4): median of 6 quiet P-core runs on beta 354028322, 21 Oct 2026, load 0.4-6 (FLUIDITY-LEAD-2). Where it is under target, max is the target; over it, the measure plus 30% for a time and 5% for renders.

projectColdMs.source: The 2,000-task project in a new tab until its first task row. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 889 at 1x on a computer (load 7 to 14), 3645 at 4x on a phone (load 19 to 31). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: A new tab, nothing in memory: 1.0 s on a computer, 2.5 s on the 4x phone (chat programme Wave C, perf-mobile.md; Nielsen's 1 s limit for the flow of thought)

listDragFrameP95Ms.source: Frame p95 while a row is carried. Row 4 lifted by its grip, carried 8 rows down in 30 moves 16 ms apart, timed from the release until it sits 8 rows down (L-1's manual order; the step is skipped on a build without grips). Median of 5 quiet P-core runs on proj-l1-2026-10-20-fe 376ce910b, 21 Oct 2026, load 0.2-2.7 (FLUIDITY-LEAD-2); the phone has no row drag.
